auditFocus: a Next.js Server Component importing browser-only APIs, hooks, or event handlers with no 'use client' boundary, or a 'use client' pushed higher up the tree than the leaf that actually needs it
a Nuxt composable (a useX function) called outside a component's setup()/<script setup> context, a plugin, or middleware, where it cannot access Nuxt's injection context

a server-only secret read without the framework's public-var guard (a bare env var reaching the client instead of NEXT_PUBLIC_-prefixed, or Nuxt's private runtimeConfig read from a component instead of its public: block)

a data-fetch that re-runs on every request when the route was clearly meant to be static/ISR (Next's revalidate) or Nuxt's cached/prerendered, or a page marked static that actually needs per-request data
a Server Action ('use server') or Nuxt server route (server/api/**) with no auth/authorization check before it touches data
a component rendering a nondeterministic value (Date.now(), Math.random(), locale-dependent formatting) directly in its render path, which mismatches between server and client hydration
buildCommands: the project's type-check script (tsc --noEmit for Next.js, or nuxi typecheck for Nuxt)
next build (Next.js) or nuxi build (Nuxt) — read the framework's own build output for prerender, route, and boundary errors, not just exit code
the project's lint script (next lint / eslint-config-next, or @nuxt/eslint-config)
the project's test script (Jest or Vitest with React Testing Library, or Vitest with Vue Test Utils/@nuxt/test-utils)
fixGuardrails: never move a 'use client' directive up to a shared layout or ancestor component to silence a Server/Client Component boundary error — narrow it to the actual leaf that needs browser APIs, state, or event handlers

never hand-import or re-path a Nuxt auto-imported composable/component to unblock a type or resolution error when the real fix is registering or exporting it correctly (checking nuxt.config.ts's imports/components dirs)
never rename a server-only secret under NEXT_PUBLIC_ or into Nuxt's public runtimeConfig just to make it reachable from client code that shouldn't have it
never delete or skip a failing SSR/hydration test, or wrap a hydration mismatch in suppressHydrationWarning/<ClientOnly>, to reach a green build instead of fixing the nondeterministic render
